title: Avant Director Album Cover
coreRelationships: The subject's gaze directs attention off-frame to the right, creating a sense of anticipation or contemplation.
The dark attire of the subject contrasts with the lighter, desaturated background, making the figure stand out.
The large, flowing script title 'Avant' visually balances the subject's mass on the left side of the composition.
The yellow tracklist sticker acts as a distinct informational overlay, breaking the visual flow of the main image.
reuseFormula: Generate a desaturated, blurred urban portrait background. Overlay a mid-shot of a dark-skinned man in a dark jacket, looking right. Add a large, elegant, dark red-brown script title 'Avant' in the upper left, with 'Director' below it in a smaller, formal script. Place a yellow rounded-rectangle sticker in the lower-left, containing tracklist information in a mix of small dark brown sans-serif and casual script fonts.
